statements.text: The Arabic Form 4-H (Appendix A, image read, reading status pending) defines a beneficial owner at ten per cent (١٠٪), while the English Form 4-H (Appendix B, text layer) states twenty-five per cent (25%).
The Proposal Due Date of 26 November 2026 is not changed by any ADD-03 provision outside this batch (VOL-I:6.1 shows the same effective text at stage ADD-03); the dates in A2 and A3 depend on it.

Note (1) of the Notes to Table 1-1 (second revision) does not change VOL-I:11.3 by itself; it confirms the 70% threshold that ADD-03:6.2 writes into the new Clause 11.3. Calling it 'unchanged' is inaccurate in substance: with 120 marks available, 70% is 84 marks, not the former 70 marks out of 100.

Note (4) adds an obligation to include an Energy Performance Statement in the Technical Proposal; it is tied to criterion G (ADD-03:T1-1/G). The format cannot be established because Appendix C is not in the evidence (A4).
Note (3) restates the scoring method of ADD-02 Note (3) without change and has no effect beyond confirmation.

Section 7 of ADD-03 is conditional: until the Authority gives the Portal notice described in 7.1 (by 12 November 2026 per A2), VOL-II:1.4 stands unamended; whether the notice will be given is not known at the evidence date. The engine has no conditional op type, so 7.2 cannot be applied as a plain replace_text.
'to be inserted after Form 4-G' in ADD-03:8.1 means after the list item that ADD-02/7.1 inserted into VOL-I:9.1 (VOL-I:9.1(e)+ADD-02, 'FORM 4-G — CYBERSECURITY COMPLIANCE UNDERTAKING').

Because 8.2 makes the Arabic text govern, the 10% threshold in the Arabic Form 4-H (F5) would prevail over the 25% in Appendix B; this needs a person and possibly a clarification to the Authority, and depends on the image reading being approved.
